wham.midnightconfig.AIR_LIFT.tooltip: Enables the Mace's 'Air Lift' ability when enchanted with Wind Control II.
wham.midnightconfig.AIR_SLAM.tooltip:
Enables the Mace's 'Air Slam' ability.

This can be performed when attacking an airborne entity.
wham.midnightconfig.DEFAULT_BOUNCE.toolt:
Enables the Mace's ability to 'Wind Bounce' even without Wind Control.

The enchantment is still obtainable and does still work as intended.
wham.midnightconfig.LOWER_LEVEL_LIFT.too: Allows 'Air Lift' ability to be used with Wind Control I.
wham.midnightconfig.REMOVE_RPS.tooltip: Prevents the mod's built-in resource packs from loading. (Restart Required)
enchantment_lore.wham:wind_control.lore:
Within this ancient tome lies the stories of an ancient civilization which took pride in the power and gifts brought by the air and winds, this is the same civilization responsible for the first documented sighting of the Breeze, or as they knew it, ''The God of Winds''.

Even though this book has hundreds of pages, it's as light as a feather.
enchantment_lore.wham:wind_control.descr:
§nWind Control§r

Max Level: II

Compatible with: Mace

Using the mace on the ground launches the wielder into the air, doing so does a considerable amount of damage to the mace.

Attacking an airborne enemy will do heavy damage an slam them on the ground.

At higher levels, the user can also 'scoop' enemies infront of them into the air.
